scientific_question: At the same 384x and 256x per-atom coordinate budgets, do causal step-zero task-gradient banks span the 0.5-TPP expert/router update and its held-out residual-write action substantially better than temporal chords or fixed BlockFHT?

causal_source.rule: Reconstruct the exact scratch model on CPU with model_seed=1337, prove that its architecture/config identity matches the terminal manifold snapshot, and construct every candidate basis only from step-zero task gradients. The terminal update is used only for oracle coordinate fitting and scoring.

gradient_definition.loss: Next-token cross entropy plus the run's router load-balance and router-z auxiliary losses, evaluated in train mode; dropout is exactly zero.
gradient_definition.direction: Negative raw task gradient for expert_c_fc, expert_c_proj, and router.weight from each independent microbatch.
gradient_definition.anti_leakage: No target checkpoint tensor, future chord, held-out token, optimizer state, or terminal activation participates in basis construction.
gradient_definition.coordinate_fit: Unrestricted ridge least-squares fit of the terminal parameter chord is an upper bound on representability, not a trainable predictor.

coordinate_families.name: coupled_four
coordinate_families.basis: Concatenate the incoming-row and outgoing-column descent directions from each of four discovery microbatches, preserving one shared coordinate per paired hidden atom; use the four router-row descent directions.

coordinate_families.name: separate_three_plus_three
coordinate_families.basis: Use the first three discovery-microbatch incoming-row directions and first three outgoing-column directions as independent coordinate banks while preserving atom identity; use the first three router directions.

controls.fixed_structured: Use the exact local BlockFHT controls and seeds from the paired-atom temporal oracle at matched coordinate counts.
controls.temporal_reference: Compare against the sealed 20-TPP paired-atom temporal result without refitting: moving exact recovery 0.024354/0.024333 and static exact recovery 0.044682/0.052700 for coupled/separate.
controls.replicate_bank: Fit and score discovery_a and discovery_b independently; the second bank is not pooled into a larger coordinate budget.

evaluation.frame: Collect held-out sparse-MLP inputs from the reconstructed step-zero model. Score exact nonlinear residual-write recovery for the terminal local expert/router update on this fixed causal frame.
secondary_metrics: paired, incoming, outgoing, and router parameter recovery
discovery-A versus discovery-B per-atom subspace overlap
microbatch gradient losses and tensor hashes

interpretation.pass_both_banks: Task/data conditioning supplies the missing atom directions at short horizon. Authorize only a 124M 5-TPP online gradient-sketch acquisition to test moving causal refresh; do not yet authorize generated training.
interpretation.pass_one_bank_only: The apparent span is batch-fragile. Reject implementation and increase data averaging without increasing coordinates before repeating the offline oracle.
interpretation.fail_both_banks: Raw task-gradient banks do not identify the required compact image. Reject gradient-conditioned latent generation and move to a preregistered functional-Jacobian/KFAC action basis, not another temporal or random chart.
interpretation.authorization: This plan authorizes only the zero-update offline oracle. It does not authorize generated-expert training, an MFU preflight, or any larger active-parameter rung.
